scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: While you used the required opening greeting at [00:00], you ended the call at [15:23] ('Thanks for calling in today, Amarachukwu, bye now') without saying 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in your final four Agent turns.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: When the customer expressed clear frustration at [00:53]–[01:26] about the overnight update breaking her voice remote, you jumped straight into a technical recap at [01:43] without offering any apology or empathetic acknowledgment.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: The customer explicitly stated at [01:26] that the remote LED flashes amber three times when she presses the microphone button, yet at [07:59] you asked 'And what colour does the light on the remote flash when you press the microphone key?'

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At [03:50] and [04:15], you blamed an internal S-Net team and disclaimed responsibility by saying 'Our software development team pushed a buggy Bluetooth stack update last night, that's their fault not customer support's.'

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: At [09:22], when the customer's thumb slipped off the button combination, you made a condescending remark: 'Look, pressing Home and Zero together for ten seconds really isn't that hard, Amarachukwu.'

grader.scenario: S-Net Stream Box voice remote losing Bluetooth pairing and microphone unresponsive after overnight OS update
grader.notes: 5 FAILs (B, E, AL, O, R) with strong technical resolution (PA, PR, RE PASS): Liam omits closing branding ([15:23]), shows zero empathy for customer frustration ([01:43]), forgets the amber 3x LED flash stated at [01:26] and re-asks at [07:59], blames the software dev team ([03:50]), and speaks condescendly when her finger slips ([09:22]), yet resolves the Bluetooth pairing live ([12:12]–[14:35]).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening at [00:00] included "thank you for calling S-Net", but closing at [15:23] said only "Thanks for calling in today, Amarachukwu, bye now" and omitted "Thank you for choosing S-Net".

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: No holds or dead-air gaps over 30 seconds occurred during the call.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:22] Liam verified the first line of the customer's billing address and four-digit account PIN before accessing the account.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:22] "Right, Amarachukwu, before we check the Stream Box, give me the first line of your billing address and your four-digit account PIN."

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed strong frustration at [00:53]–[01:26] (`-28.0` sentiment), and Liam responded at [01:43] with a dry technical recap without any apology or empathy statement anywhere in the call.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:43] "So just to recap the technical symptoms you are reporting, Amarachukwu: after your S-Net Stream Box installed the overnight StreamOS 6.4.2 update, your voice remote loses its Bluetooth pairing and pressing the microphone button fails to trigger voice input on the television."

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: At [01:26] Amarachukwu stated "the little LED light at the top of the remote just flashes amber three times", but at [07:59] Liam asked "and what colour does the light on the remote flash when you press the microphone key?"

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [03:50] "Our software development team pushed a buggy Bluetooth stack update last night, that's their fault not customer support's."

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [09:22] "Look, pressing Home and Zero together for ten seconds really isn't that hard, Amarachukwu."

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [02:17]–[03:28] Liam asked appropriate diagnostic questions regarding the System Info Bluetooth controller revision, battery age, line-of-sight soundbar interference, and other paired Bluetooth devices.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [10:59]–[14:35] After clearing the BLE Bond Table EEPROM and resetting the remote, Amarachukwu confirmed live Bluetooth pairing, tested voice commands ('Open BBC iPlayer' and 'Switch to Channel 4 HD'), and verified persistence across a standby cycle.
